title: Aggregate trades into OHLC bars
statement: Trades [t_ms, price, qty] arrive in time order. Aggregate them into bars of bar_ms milliseconds aligned to multiples of bar_ms. For each non-empty bar output [bar_start, open, high, low, close, volume, vwap] (vwap = Σ price·qty / Σ qty).
hints: bar_start = t − t mod bar_ms; flush the current bar when it changes.
Empty bars are skipped, not emitted.

solution.explanation: A single pass with one open bar. Production details: bars aligned to exchange time (not arrival time), late or out-of-order trades (a reorder buffer or a correction policy), whether to emit empty bars (here: no), and VWAP accumulated in a wider type to avoid drift. This is the first transformation in almost every research data pipeline.
